💡 This review uniquely reframes hydrogel electrolytes as dynamic regulators of Zn²⁺ solvation, ion transport, and interfacial chemistry, not merely mechanical quasi-solid separators. 💡 This work reveals electric-field-induced deformation in PAM hydrogel electrolytes via Zn–O/Zn–N adhesion, causing interfacial separation and reduced battery life.
